UNSPIKE.SECTION_ABOUT_DOC: On a Raspberry Pi 4, Pi 400 or Compute Module 4 running the 32-bit kernel, the version of Node that Volumio runs on keeps every core of the processor busy for minutes after each start. It does so through a feature of the kernel called io_uring, which does not work properly on that kernel. While it lasts the player is hot, slow to answer and slow to show its screens. Unspike has Volumio start with that feature left unused: before Volumio's services start, on that kernel only, it sets UV_USE_IO_URING=0 for them. It changes no file of Volumio's. Switching the plugin off or uninstalling it puts everything back from the next start.
UNSPIKE.RESTART_MSG: Unspike works from the moment the player starts, so it has done nothing yet. Restart the player once.
